name: Trinity
summary: Parsed Labour & Human Rights Policy from Inclusive Workplace policy - Updated - GRW 29-07.docx.

declaration.preface: At Trinity, we prioritize our team members above all else. Our policy reflects our commitment to fostering a workplace that upholds the dignity, safety, and rights of every individual. We recognize the intrinsic value of our team members and are dedicated to creating an environment that promotes fairness, equality, and respect. Through this policy, we aim to ensure that every member of our team feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive.
declaration.declaration:
Trinity Logistics, Inc. is dedicated to promoting and safeguarding the rights and well-being of our team members. Our primary objective is to establish and maintain a work environment that upholds labor standards, human rights principles, and ethical practices. Through this policy, we aim to:

Ensure compliance with local and national labor laws and regulations.

Foster a culture of respect, dignity, and fairness among all team members.

Provide avenues for open communication, feedback, and resolution of issues.

Educate and empower team members to understand their rights and responsibilities within the workplace.
declaration.scope: This Inclusive Workplace policy applies to all team members of Trinity Logistics, Inc. across all operational locations.

Employee Health and Safety: We aim to foster a proactive health and safety culture by ensuring widespread employee participation in relevant training, which will include regular safety workshops and comprehensive risk assessments.
We commit to providing continuous mental health support to all employees, maintaining our dedication to overall well-being through accessible counseling services and mental health awareness programs.
Working Conditions: We strive to enhance employee satisfaction through regular feedback and improvements based on annual survey results, implementing action plans to address key concerns and improving work-life balance through flexible working hours.
Our goal is to reduce employee turnover by addressing key areas of engagement and satisfaction, introducing mentorship programs and career development opportunities.
We aim to provide ergonomic workstations to the majority of our employees to ensure comfort and well-being, conducting workspace assessments and providing necessary equipment upgrades.

We commit to fostering regular employee engagement through quarterly meetings to maintain strong communication and alignment, while encouraging open dialogue and participation in decision-making processes.
Career Management: We are dedicated to providing sufficient training hours for each employee to support professional growth and skill development by organizing tailored training sessions and access to online learning platforms.
Our goal is to ensure that most employees have personal development plans to guide their career advancement, with regular one-on-one reviews and goal-setting initiatives.
Child Labour and Forced Labour: We are committed to maintaining zero incidents of child labor or forced labor within our operations by implementing rigorous audits and supplier vetting processes, alongside robust awareness training for employees.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We aim to ensure the majority of employees receive diversity training annually, fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace through targeted training programs and promoting diversity in recruitment and leadership roles.
Our goal is to increase employee satisfaction with diversity initiatives, ensuring a positive and inclusive work environment through continuous feedback loops and active diversity task forces.
Discrimination and Harassment: The company will continue to enforce its Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) framework by ensuring all employment-related decisions—such as hiring, compensation, promotion, and disciplinary actions—remain free from discrimination, in full compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
We are committed to maintaining a workplace culture that does not tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment, ensuring a respectful and inclusive environment for all team members.

We aim to reinforce awareness and accountability by conducting annual company-wide training on discrimination, harassment prevention, and respectful workplace behavior for all team members, with a focus on real-world scenarios and inclusive practices.

Trinity will also maintain open and confidential reporting systems to address discrimination and harassment concerns, promoting a safe environment where all employees feel empowered to report issues without fear of retaliation.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: We are committed to maintaining zero human rights violations across our logistics partners, ensuring ethical practices throughout our supply chain by conducting regular partner evaluations, audits, and establishing stringent human rights criteria in supplier contracts.
Labor relation: We aim to strengthen collaborative labor relations by regularly engaging with employee representatives through structured dialogue sessions, ensuring open communication and addressing concerns promptly to foster mutual trust and respect.

We are committed to maintaining a positive and cooperative work environment by implementing regular conflict resolution training for both management and employees, ensuring that workplace disputes are handled fairly and efficiently.

responsibilities.duty: The Executive Leadership Team is responsible for championing the implementation of this policy throughout the organization. They are tasked with providing visible leadership, allocating necessary resources, and fostering a culture that prioritizes the well-being and rights of all team members.

The Team Services department plays a pivotal role in ensuring the effective dissemination of this policy to all employees. Our Team Services including the People Operations team is responsible for facilitating training sessions, managing grievance procedures, and monitoring compliance with labor laws and human rights standards.

Department managers and team leads are accountable for implementing the specific measures outlined in this policy within their respective teams. They are responsible for ensuring that team members receive adequate training, have access to necessary resources, and are supported in maintaining safe and respectful working conditions.

Every individual within Trinity Logistics, Inc. is responsible for upholding the principles outlined in this policy. Team members are encouraged to actively participate in creating a workplace culture that promotes fairness, equality, and respect for all.

policy.monitoring:
Trinity Logistics, Inc. is committed to fostering a transparent and accountable reporting mechanism to address any concerns related to labor standards and human rights violations. The following reporting channels are available to employees, contractors, partners, and clients:

Internal Reporting: Employees are encouraged to report any violations of this policy or concerns regarding labor standards and human rights issues to their immediate supervisor, department manager, or the Team Services department. Trinity Logistics guarantees confidentiality and non-retaliation for individuals reporting in good faith.

Anonymous Hotline: Trinity Logistics provides an anonymous hotline for individuals who wish to report concerns anonymously. This hotline is managed by a third-party service provider to ensure confidentiality and impartiality in handling reports.

External Reporting: In addition to internal channels, individuals have the option to report concerns to relevant external authorities or regulatory bodies, such as labor agencies or human rights organizations, if they feel their concerns are not adequately addressed internally.
policy.reviewMechanism:
Team Service Director is committed to annually reviewing and evaluating the effectiveness of this Inclusive workplace policy and labor and human right policy to ensure continuous improvement and alignment with evolving standards. The following review mechanisms are established:

Periodic Audits: Trinity Logistics conducts regular audits of its operations to assess compliance with labor laws, human rights standards, and the provisions outlined in this policy. These audits include both internal assessments and external audits conducted by independent third parties.

Stakeholder Feedback: Trinity Logistics actively seeks feedback from team members and other stakeholders to gauge the effectiveness of this policy in promoting a safe, fair, and respectful workplace. Feedback is collected through surveys, focus groups, and other engagement initiatives.

Policy Review Committee: Trinity Logistics has established a dedicated committee responsible for overseeing the review and revision of this policy as needed. The committee comprises representatives from executive leadership team, the Team Services department, legal counsel, and relevant stakeholders to ensure comprehensive review and alignment with best practices.
